summary: Iter45 Phase 1 Supplier Management — full backend + UI verification. Ran existing pytest suite (6/6 pass) and added a new multi-company-isolation regression test file (5/5 pass, 11/11 total). Verified UI end-to-end: sidebar nav-suppliers routes to /suppliers/list, all 7 tabs (List/Add/Vehicles/Payments/Statement/Outstanding/P&L) render, Supplier Add form has all 18 fields incl opening_balance + opening_balance_type dropdown, creating a supplier redirects to list and it is searchable. Payments flow works end-to-end: picker → sp-* form → sp-add-btn creates a row → sp-del-* opens sp-delete-modal → sp-delete-reason + sp-confirm-delete removes row and shows 'Payment deleted' toast. Ledger returns opening row + closing balance (sup-led-closing). Outstanding tab displays sup-out-total (₹11,13,625.60). Vehicles tab picker renders. Multi-company isolation is HARD-VERIFIED: creating a supplier under Company A never appears in Company B list, direct GET/ledger/outstanding return 404 cross-company, dashboard is scoped, and duplicate names are allowed across companies (per-company uniqueness). Deletion reason < 3 chars → 422 as required.

issues: Supplier picker is a native <select> with ~58 options; consider shadcn combobox with type-ahead for better UX at scale. Not a blocker.
Uses native browser date picker for opening date; consistent with rest of app, acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: suppliers-dashboard iterates ALL suppliers and runs _build_ledger per-supplier (N x trip/payment queries). With 58 suppliers already seeded this could get slow — consider a single aggregation pipeline or caching.
Halting is intentionally excluded from supplier ledger (comment says 'skip'). Confirm this matches business intent for Phase 2 (currently transparent-only accounting for halting).

delete_supplier is soft-delete (is_active=false). List endpoint returns inactive suppliers unless active_only=true is passed — Suppliers List UI currently shows Active status; verify UX intent (may want default active_only=true or a filter chip).
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 (also usable as cookie session_token)
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral suppliers (PYTEST_*, E2E Sup <ts>) and one payment (soft-deleted) during tests. Multi-company iso test may create a 'PYTEST Iso Co B' company if only one existed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter45 Phase 1 is stable. When Phase 2 lands (advanced filters, monthly PDF export, Outstanding aging), rerun test_iter45_supplier_module_phase1.py + test_iter45_supplier_multicompany_isolation.py as regression. Session cookie must be Secure+SameSite=None on the preview host. Native <select> pickers with data-testid can be selected via page.select_option(). Test uses X-Company-Id header for isolation asserts.
